function.description: Return detailed information about a specific security advisory, PSIRT, or vulnerability affecting network devices by advisory ID. The response includes: advisory ID, number of affected devices (deviceCount), CVE IDs (cveIds), publication URL (publicationUrl), CVSS base score (cvssBaseScore), security impact rating (securityImpactRating), and a list of vulnerable and first fixed versions (firstFixedVersionsList) with mappings of vulnerableVersion to fixedVersions. Use this API to answer questions like 'Get security advisory cisco-sa-20160525-ipv6 details', 'Show me details for advisory CVE-2024-1234', or 'Lookup PSIRT by advisory ID'. This tool provides full advisory details when given a unique advisory identifier.
function.name: api_getSecurityAdvisoryAffectingTheNetworkDevicesById

cveIds.description: CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) ID of the advisory

cvssBaseScore.description: Common Vulnerability Scoring System(CVSS) base score

deviceCount.description: Number of devices which are vulnerable to this advisory

firstFixedVersionsList.description: Vulnerable version and the first fixed versions for the vulnerable version

fixedVersions.description: First versions that have the fix for the advisory

vulnerableVersion.description: Version that is vulnerable to the advisory

publicationUrl.description: Url for getting advisory details on cisco website

securityImpactRating.description: 'CRITICAL' - the advisory requires immediate mitigation. 'HIGH' - the advisory requires priority mitigation
